# Install Paneflow

> Choose the Paneflow installer for Linux, macOS, or Windows, then follow the guide to install it and verify that it works.

Canonical: https://paneflow.dev/docs/installation

     scripts/sync-public-docs.ts in the site repo. -->

Paneflow is available as a native app for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
Choose the guide for your operating system and processor below. You do
not need Rust or a build toolchain to install a release package.

## Choose your platform

- [Install on Linux](/docs/installation/linux): AppImage, .deb, .rpm, or .tar.gz for x86_64 and ARM64. Choose the format for your distribution and check the Vulkan requirements.
- [Install on macOS](/docs/installation/macos): Homebrew or a signed and notarized .dmg for Apple Silicon. Intel Mac builds are not available.
- [Install on Windows](/docs/installation/windows): Native .msi installer for Windows 10 and 11 on x86_64. The guide also covers WSL2 for Linux-based development.

## After installation

Open Paneflow and follow your platform guide to check the installed
version. The guide also explains how to make the `paneflow` command
available in your terminal.

Paneflow runs the shells and CLI agents installed on your machine.
Install agents such as Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode separately and
follow their sign-in instructions. Then use the [getting started
guide](/docs) to open a terminal pane and launch your first agent.

## Where settings and sessions are stored

Paneflow stores its configuration, saved workspace state, managed
worktrees, and helper binaries in `~/.paneflow` on Linux and macOS, or
`%USERPROFILE%\.paneflow` on Windows. Set `PANEFLOW_HOME` to use another
directory. See the [configuration guide](/docs/configuration) for details.

Terminal sessions run in a separate host process. When quitting, you can
keep them running and reconnect when you reopen the app, as long as the
host and machine remain running.

## Get help with installation

If your terminal cannot find `paneflow`, follow the PATH instructions in
your platform guide. For launch errors, consult the [troubleshooting
guide](/docs/troubleshooting). If the problem persists, [report an
installation issue on GitHub](https://github.com/arthjean/paneflow/issues)
with your operating system, Paneflow version, and error message.
